advisor.no_road_access.title: A building has no road beside it
advisor.no_road_access.body: Build a dirt road touching its walls so carts and residents can reach it.
advisor.outside_storehouse_reach.title: A building is out of storehouse reach
advisor.outside_storehouse_reach.body: Lay road within a storehouse's reach so its goods can join the island pool.
advisor.good_shortage.title: A good is running short
advisor.good_shortage.body: The island wants more of it each day than it can supply. Add another producer or ease demand.
advisor.house_cannot_advance.title: Houses are ready but cannot advance
advisor.house_cannot_advance.body: Their needs are met, yet the step up is blocked. Bring in the missing materials or unlock the next tier.
advisor.no_workforce.title: A tier is short of workers
advisor.no_workforce.body: Its buildings ask for more hands than its residents supply. Build more houses of that tier; houses wait to advance while their workers are needed.
advisor.research_idle.title: Knowledge is waiting for a choice
advisor.research_idle.body: Pick a technology to study so the island's knowledge is put to use.
advisor.civic_idle.title: Culture is waiting for a choice
advisor.civic_idle.body: Pick a civic to adopt so the island's culture is put to use.
